title: The Public garden of the town
subtitle: 国家公民 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 国家公民（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·国家与公民）
meta: 主题语境：国家公民（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·国家与公民）　|　核心词汇：public　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 public 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1971 the herder wrote of ① a public garden of the town in the ledger, and everybody in the pasture said at once that it was ② so public that nobody in the pasture would go near it. Three winters on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the herder, who never explained anything, had done it in public and gone home; it was the public ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the public garden of the town that anybody there had ever seen, or so the ledger for December 1965 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too public to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the neighbour who had come to help; the public ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the rope at the far pen, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a public talk about the plan, and said that no neighbour in his right mind would call it ⑥ as public as the talk about the plan they had once had in the old pasture. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was public or not, and he said so.

By 1978 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the ledger. What the line asked for was ⑦ something public, and nothing besides. The neighbour from the next pasture called the whole plan ⑧ quite public; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the ledger kept the names of the public ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1981, in silence, she wrote of another public garden of the town in the same ledger, and the work, which took two winters, seemed ⑨ no less public than anybody had expected. ⑩ The public talk about the plan that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1983, was the one she could never quite name; the public ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 公共（前置定语 a public garden of the town：1971 年牧人在牧群台账里记下的那件公共的花园）
B. adj. 公共／公开（两处加强说法：so public that … 与 no less public than …）
C. adj. 公共／公开（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 公共（表语 too public to do：母亲觉得它太公共，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 公开（前置定语 a public talk about the plan：叔叔把整件事称作一桩公开的讨论）
F. adj. 公开（同级比较 as public as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩关于方案的公开讨论相比）
G. adj. 公开（后置定语 something public：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 公开（受程度副词修饰 quite public：那位邻人的评价）

items.q: a public garden of the town
the public garden of the town that
a public talk about the plan
The public talk about the plan that

answers.why: public 意为“公共”，1971 年牧人在牧群台账里记下的是“一件公共的花园”，此处作前置定语 a public garden of the town。
public 意为“公共”，此处用 so public that 结构，说它公共到牧场里没人敢靠近。
public 意为“公共”，牧群台账上 十二月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的公共镇上的公共花园，等于最高级的说法。
public 意为“公共”，母亲认为这件东西“太公共了，谁也用不上”，too public to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
public 意为“公开”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩公开的讨论”，此处作前置定语 a public talk about the plan。
public 意为“公开”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩关于方案的公开讨论一样公开”，同级比较用 as public as。
public 意为“公开”，牧群台账上那半行字要的是“公开的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something public。
public 意为“公开”，邻牧场来的那位邻人认为这套计划“相当公开”，quite 修饰原级 public。
public 意为“公开”，no less public than 表示“其公开不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之公开不亚于任何人的预料。
public 意为“公开”，母亲 1983 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的公开讨论”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1971 年，牧人在牧群台账里记下了一件公共的花园。（a public garden of the town）
它公共到牧场里没有一个人敢靠近。（so public that …）
母亲觉得它太公共，谁也用不上。（too public to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩公开的讨论。（a public talk about the plan）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩关于方案的公开讨论一样公开。（as public as …）
到了 1978 年，牧群台账上只剩半行字：要的是一件公开的东西。（something public）
answers: In 1971 the herder wrote of a public garden of the town in the ledger.
It was so public that nobody in the pasture would go near it.
My mother thought it too public to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a public talk about the plan.
He said nobody would call it as public as the talk about the plan they had once had.
By 1978 the ledger asked for nothing but something public.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 public 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1971 the herder wrote of a public garden of the town in the ledger, and nobody forgot it.
It was the public garden of the town that anybody there had ever seen, or so the ledger says.
My mother thought it too public to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a public talk about the plan, and nobody argued with him.
The neighbour from the next pasture called the plan quite public, and everybody laughed.
The public ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
